basic_details.job_title: NeGD Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 8 Deputy General Manager, Senior Manager and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The National e-Governance Division (NeGD), an independent business division under the Digital India Corporation, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, is inviting applications for 8 posts purely on contract basis, initially for 3 years and extendable as per the requirement of the project. There is one vacancy in each post. The maximum age limit is 55 years on the closing date of receipt of application. Eligible candidates may apply online at https://ora.digitalindiacorporation.in/ and the last date is 15 November 2026.

how_to_apply: The notice asks eligible candidates to apply online at https://ora.digitalindiacorporation.in/ and states that the last date for submission of applications is 15.11.2026. It adds that details can be downloaded from the official websites of DIC and NeGD, www.dic.gov.in and www.negd.gov.in. The notice does not describe the online form steps.

A No Objection Certificate from the employer, for candidates already in regular or contractual employment under Central/State Government, Public Sector Undertakings or Autonomous Bodies. They are expected to apply through proper channel or attach the certificate with the application, or produce it at the time of interview.
important_instructions: The place of posting shall be in New Delhi but transferable to project locations of NeGD as per existing policy of NeGD/DIC. The positions are purely temporary in nature for the project of NeGD/DIC; appointees shall not derive any right or claim for permanent appointment at NeGD/DIC or on any vacancy existing or advertised in future. NeGD reserves the right to terminate the appointments of all positions with a notice of one month or without any notice by paying one month's salary in lieu of the notice period. NeGD reserves the right to fill all or some or none of the positions advertised without assigning any reason. The designation of selected candidates shall be mapped as per the existing designation policy of NeGD. The prescribed eligibility criteria may be relaxed for candidates possessing exceptional qualifications, experience or suitability for the position, subject to the approval of the Competent Authority. For queries, contact the HR Team, National e Governance Division, 4th Floor, Electronics Niketan, 6-CGO, Complex Lodhi Road, New Delhi - 110003, Tel: 24301932, Email: [email protected].

content_sections.heading: About NeGD
content_sections.text: NeGD is an independent business division under the Digital India Corporation, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, at Electronics Niketan, 6, CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi - 110003. The notice says it supports MeitY in programme management and implementation of e-governance projects of various Ministries and Departments at the Central and State levels. Initiatives named in the notice include DigiLocker, UMANG, Poshan Tracker, OpenForge Platform, API Setu, National Academic Depository, Academic Bank of Credits and Learning Management System.

content_sections.text: NeGD has advertised 8 posts with one vacancy each, so the total is 8. The notice gives no category-wise break-up.

rows.position: Special Projects _ Deputy General Manager/Senior Manager/Manager

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The age limit is the same for all posts: the maximum age limit shall be 55 years on the closing date of receipt of application. The notice prints no minimum age and no age relaxation by category. Post-wise qualification and experience are below. Regulatory: strong writing and analytical skills with the ability to simplify complex regulatory topics; good understanding of the Indian startup ecosystem and regulatory environment; ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities and drive outcomes. The post reports to the Director. Marketing: a master's degree is very much preferred and desired; graphic design and video editing skills (Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere et al) are a big plus; strong digital marketing expertise and extensive knowledge of brand management, content creation and media strategies. Recognition (Deputy General Manager/Senior Manager): a relevant Master's degree is preferred; demonstrated experience independently managing teams and high-volume digital application or query workflows; strong proficiency in spreadsheet, dashboard and data tools. Recognition (Associate): CA / CS / Lawyer from Premier Institute will be preferred; experience at a Consulting Firm / Government Advisory / Leading corporate will be preferred; experience in policy facilitation or project management with the State Govt. or Govt. of India is a plus. Special Projects (Deputy General Manager/Senior Manager/Manager): proficiency in Microsoft Office (Advanced Excel, PowerPoint); knowledge of BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) is a plus. Special Projects (Associate): prior experience in working with government projects or initiatives is advantageous; strong proficiency in MS Office tools; familiarity with public sector processes, entrepreneurship policies and the startup ecosystem is a plus. Income Tax Exemption (Associate): working proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word; understanding of the Indian startup ecosystem, DPIIT recognition and startup-related tax incentives; exposure to e-governance portals, workflow automation, user-acceptance testing or process improvement. Information Technology (Deputy General Manager): knowledge of Backend languages such as Node.js, Python, Java or similar; Frontend such as Angular, React, Vue; DevOps: AWS, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes; Database: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch; APIs: RESTful APIs, OAuth 2.0, API Gateways; experience with government tech platforms, digital governance projects or large-scale B2B/B2G platforms. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: NeGD Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The role focuses on identifying issues faced by startups and the wider startup ecosystem, including incubators, investors, accelerators and other partners, and working with government departments to resolve them. Policy Strategy and Issue Identification: track challenges faced by startups, incubators, investors and ecosystem partners and build a clear policy agenda. Stakeholder Coordination: work with ministries, regulators, industry bodies, incubators and founders to gather feedback and push practical solutions. Drafting Notes and Policy Inputs: prepare issue notes, recommendations, briefing documents and consultation responses. Regulatory Tracking and Analysis: monitor government notifications, regulations and policy changes and explain their impact on startups. Consultations and Working Groups: lead meetings, roundtables and working groups and convert feedback into structured recommendations. Program Support: support Startup India programs that require policy alignment, such as funding schemes, incentives, ease of doing business and new initiatives. Internal Coordination and Leadership: work with internal teams, guide associates and ensure timely, high quality delivery of policy work. Representation and Advocacy: represent Startup India in meetings with ministries, regulators and industry groups. Create and maintain a strong, consistent brand identity and narrative across all channels and oversee brand positioning, messaging and visual identity. Work with the larger Invest India Brand Communications team on marketing, content and media efforts for the Startup India initiative. Build a pro-active, agile and scalable social media strategy across all functions of Startup India and develop integrated marketing strategies aligned with its objectives and vision. Manage brand health and perception, and oversee creation of content for websites, blogs, social media, reports, brochures, videos and other marketing materials, aligned with brand guidelines and including vernacular messaging. Plan and execute media strategies across digital, social and traditional channels; manage relationships with media partners, agencies and influencers. Lead digital marketing initiatives including SEO, SEM, social media marketing, email campaigns and online advertising. Use data analytics to measure campaign performance and share regular reports; implement marketing automation tools. Develop and manage the marketing budget; work with cross-functional teams within Startup India and engage the central marketing agency and external partners. Conduct market analysis regularly; build, mentor and lead the marketing team towards goals and KPIs. The role is part of the Startup India team at Invest India, expected to lead Marketing, Branding, Content and Media responsibilities, with a proven track record of leading large-scale marketing campaigns and high-performing cross-functional teams. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NeGD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 8 vacancies, one in each of the 8 advertised posts, under Advertisement No. N/32/2026-NeGD.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NeGD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications is 15.11.2026. The advertisement is dated 12.11.2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for NeGD posts?
faq.answer: It differs by post. Most posts ask for a Bachelor's or Master's degree in the fields named for the post, while the Information Technology Deputy General Manager post asks for a Master's degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology or associated fields. Experience ranges from 0-4 years to 15 - 25 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for NeGD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 55 years on the closing date of receipt of application, for all posts.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for NeGD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates may apply online at https://ora.digitalindiacorporation.in/ by 15.11.2026.

faq.question: Q6. How will NeGD select candidates?
faq.answer: Applications are screened on qualifications, age and relevant experience, and only shortlisted candidates are invited for interview. NeGD may fix higher thresholds for screening and limit the number of candidates called.

faq.question: Q7. Is the NeGD job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The posts are purely on contract basis, initially for 3 years and extendable as per the requirement of the project, and appointees have no right or claim to permanent appointment.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the NeGD posting be?
faq.answer: The place of posting is New Delhi, but it is transferable to project locations of NeGD as per existing policy of NeGD/DIC.

faq.question: Q9. Do government employees need a No Objection Certificate?
faq.answer: Candidates already in regular or contractual employment under Central/State Government, PSUs or Autonomous Bodies are expected to apply through proper channel or attach a No Objection Certificate with the application, or produce it at the time of interview.

faq.question: Q10. Can the eligibility criteria be relaxed?
faq.answer: Yes, the prescribed criteria may be relaxed for candidates with exceptional qualifications, experience or suitability, subject to the approval of the Competent Authority.
